why: Under 50 MB free, WAL growth and boundary writes fail - silently, which is the actual problem. The resume guarantee is a promise; below the threshold it must be withdrawn out loud.

cases.why: EC-PER-04: 12 MB free at session start.
One byte under the threshold is still under it.
Exactly at the threshold is fine.
A probe that returns a negative reading is treated as empty, never as plenty.
